title: pretalx: 2026.1.2 -> 2026.2.0
reason: Applicable: changed-file list includes nixos/modules/services/web-apps/pretalx.nix. Wired test confirmed: nixos/tests/all-tests.nix at head (9b2a1f97) contains 'pretalx = runTest ./web-apps/pretalx.nix;' (line 1400), and nixos/tests/web-apps/pretalx.nix exists and exercises services.pretalx.enable in a container node.
targets_toml: single target pretalx, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,pretalx], watch=[enable, celery.enable]. The real diff DELETES the mkOption declaration for services.pretalx.celery.enable (base lines 140-148: `enable = lib.mkOption { type = lib.types.bool; default = true; ... };` inside the celery submodule) and replaces it with `imports = [ (lib.mkRemovedOptionModule [ "services" "pretalx" "celery" "enable" ] "Celery is now always required.") ];`. celery.enable's declaration-deletion is a real, textually-touched mkOption removal, so it was added to watch alongside baseline enable.
exit_code_note: Nonzero exit codes reflect real summary content, not a crash: check-base exit 1 corresponds to summary.finding=1 (celery.enable verdict OBA001 on base), check-head exit 2 corresponds to summary.inconclusive=1 (celery.enable verdict OptionNotFound on head), audit-diff exit 2 corresponds to summary.finding_became_inconclusive=1. All three commands produced complete, well-formed JSON output (no stderr, no truncation).

identities.subject: celery.enable
identities.message: no mkOption declaration found for this watched option

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.raw_fact: This is the exact asymmetric-transition pattern the task flagged (precedent: firezone provision-removal, bootspec). base has 4 predicate_attempts against cfg.celery.enable (lib.optionals at pretalx.nix:25, lib.optionalString at :284 and :295, lib.mkIf at :526), all witnessed=false against the test's only assignment (services.pretalx.enable=true; celery.enable is never set in the test, so base default (true) applies but the predicate-witness mechanism still records OBA001, i.e. no direct test-assignment evidence for celery.enable specifically). head reports OptionNotFound because the mkOption declaration for celery.enable no longer exists in the head module (correctly reflecting the real mkRemovedOptionModule swap) -- discovered_options in check-head.json indeed has no celery.enable entry, and discovered_predicates/resolved_predicates no longer reference cfg.celery.enable at all (the 4 predicate sites from base are gone from head's predicate list, consistent with the PR's diff removing all 4 `cfg.celery.enable`-gated code paths and making celery unconditional).
